newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel looks to 130.94, but gap calls.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel looks to 130.94, but gap calls.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF were looking to the upside on Tuesday but first need to fill a gap below the market down to 130.60, technical analysts said.

"Notionnel is going to get dragged higher, to have a go at the July 23 low at 130.94," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "But before New York comes in, it might try to fill that gap."
September notionnel futures set a high of 130.60 on Monday, but so far on Tuesday have only reached a low of 130.64. They were trading down 0.10 at 130.66 by 0730 GMT.
Below the gap, a zone of support was pegged around congestion between 130.60/55.
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell noted in a research document that notionnel posted an inside day on Monday. They said upside gains were expected to be limited to the 130.90 area.
They said the contract's failure to break above an uptrend line at 130.76 had undermined its bullish phase. A resumption of the bullish trend faces resistance near 131.06, an intraday retracement.
Celaya also saw resistance at the 131.24 contract high.
At the short end, September Pibor futures were up one basis point at 96.50.
